long_biography.plain_text:
Joseph M. Pizza pursued music with Ronald Mannino before the pair founded Interchem Corporation in 1981. They began from a kitchen and built a pharmaceutical brokerage connecting drugmakers with suppliers of active ingredients and other materials. That sourcing role became the foundation of a business offering technical, regulatory and custom-manufacturing support.

Pizza remains Interchem's president and is a director and significant shareholder of Interchem Europe. His interest in music continued alongside the pharmaceutical business: he and Mannino operated a recording studio that grew out of work for Interchem. His career has therefore spanned both the practical supply chain behind medicines and creative production.
